deadline.value: First deadline February 1; applications after that are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Carleton operates on a rolling admission timeline after the first deadline of February 1st

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the official pages checked.

supervisor.value: You do not need a supervisor before applying, though you can contact faculty whose research interests you.
supervisor.quote: Do I need to have a supervisor before I apply? | No, you do not have to have a supervisor lined up.

funding.value: Funding (TAs about CAD 12,089 a year, scholarships, RAs) is considered at admission and depends on applicant numbers and available funds; international PhD students are considered for a tuition bursary (IDTS).
funding.quote: Consideration for funding, is made at the time of admission. | The number of TAs and scholarships are awarded depend on the number of applicants and availability of funds.

entry_route.value: A master's in mathematics (or equivalent) with at least B+ is the normal requirement.
entry_route.quote: The normal requirement for admission to the Ph.D. program is a master's degree in mathematics, or the equivalent, with at least B+ standing.

notes: Specializations: Applied Mathematics, Probability and Statistics, Pure Mathematics. Part of the Ottawa-Carleton Institute for Mathematics and Statistics (OCIMS).
name: PhD in Mathematics and Statistics
